title: API for developers & agents
intro: A versioned, read-only JSON API over our owned component catalog. Built for engineers and AI agents: stable URLs, cacheable responses, no key required during the beta.
exampleNote: Every response is JSON with permissive CORS, and is cacheable.
scope: Read-only. Returns factual specifications entered from manufacturer datasheets, each with provenance and a last-checked date. No live pricing, stock, lead times, or purchase authorization. We never host datasheets — each component links to a manufacturer-listing search.
version: The path is versioned (/api/v1). Breaking changes ship under a new version, and the static site stays available even if the API is paused.
coming: A later release adds registered access and per-key rate limits for higher-volume use. The beta is open and read-only.
